blocks.text: (Satellite image from Pagasa) MANILA, Philippines — The trough or extension of Severe Tropical Storm Choi-Wan off Northern Luzon and outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) is forecast to continue to bring rains to the Visayas and Mindanao on Saturday, Oct. 3, according to the state weather bureau. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported in its 5 p.m. weather advisory on Friday that the extension of Choi-Wan will bring cloudy skies with scattered rains to Mindanao, Western Visayas, Negros Island Region, and Central Visayas.
